subject: AWS Seller-Partner Onboarding: PDM/PSM Intro & Marketplace Next Steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Amir Khan <amir.khan@northern-tech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: AWS seller-partner onboarding: PDM/PSM intro & next steps

Hi Amir —

Great to meet yesterday on the product call. Following up with a concise set of next steps so we can get Northern Tech listed and enrolled for AWS co-sell support. High-level asks:

1) ACE registration: please complete the ACE registration (link below) and share the registration confirmation PDF when it's available. That kicks off the AWS intake.
2) PDM/PSM intro: we'd like to introduce you to our PDM (Karthik) and the AWS PSM once ACE is submitted. Karthik will outline technical readiness and the go-to-market checklist.
3) Timeline & launch goals: can you confirm a target marketplace listing date or quarter (e.g., target: Q1 2026)? That helps us prioritize resources.

I've attached a short checklist for the ACE registration and our marketplace one-pager. I also attached a template mutual-action-plan (MAP) we can edit together — typical items are listing assets, security evidence, pricing, and joint webinar/date.

Proposed times for a 30-min intro call with PDM/PSM next week: Wed 11/19 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 11/20 9:00–9:30 PT. Tell me what works and I'll send the calendar invite.

Thanks — excited to partner.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachments: aws-registration-checklist.pdf (PDF summary, 1 page); redwood-marketplace-onepager.pdf (PDF, 2 pages); mutual-action-plan.xlsx (Excel, template)
Links: AWS ACE register: https://aws.amazon.com/partner/ace-register
From: Amir Khan <amir.khan@northern-tech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@northern-tech.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS seller-partner onboarding: PDM/PSM intro & next steps

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear checklist.

We will start the ACE registration today. Priya (cc'd) runs partnerships and procurement on our side; she will own the registration and gather the required artifacts. A couple quick Qs before we move:

- For security evidence, can you confirm the minimum items AWS expects for listing? Is SOC2 Type II sufficient initially or do we need anything else?
- Regarding pricing model: are placeholders acceptable while we finalize on our side, or does AWS require final pricing during ACE intake?

Both proposed times are doable — Wed 11/19 10:00 PT works for Priya and me. Please send an invite.

Next: I will follow up with Priya after we kick off the registration and attach the confirmation PDF to this thread.

Best,
Amir Khan
Head of Product, Northern Tech
amir.khan@northern-tech.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Amir Khan <amir.khan@northern-tech.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@northern-tech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@aws-partner.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Nov 2025 07:48:00 -0800
Subject: Introductions — PDM from Redwood (technical readiness & MAP)

Hi Amir / Priya —

Thanks Marissa. Quick intro: I'm Karthik, Product Development Manager for AWS partnerships at Redwood. I'll own the technical onboarding checklist and coordinate with the AWS PSM (Lisa cc'd) on go-to-market steps. A few items for the intro call tomorrow:

- Technical readiness: container image & registry access, endpoint auth, sample payloads, and observability hooks (tracing/logging).
- Security artifacts: SOC2 PDF + data flow diagram + any PCI/PHI constraints you have. If SOC2 is available, that's a good starting point for ACE intake.
- Listing assets: logo files, short/long descriptions, screenshots, and 1–2 demo scripts for the marketplace listing page.
- Success metrics: please come prepared with 3 KPIs you want the co-sell to drive (e.g., SQLs from marketplace, demo requests per month, and revenue target for first 6 months).

I edited the MAP template with a first pass of tech deliverables — attaching a small doc to the meeting invite.

See you Wed 11/19 at 10:00 PT. I will be online 10 minutes early to triage any access issues.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
PDM, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0219

Attachments referenced: MAP (technical tab) — will be attached to calendar invite.

Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS seller-partner onboarding: PDM/PSM intro & next steps

Hi all —

Quick update from Northern Tech: we completed the ACE registration this morning and attached the registration confirmation (see link). SOC2 Type II is in progress with an expected completion in Jan; we will provide the SOC2 report as soon as it's available. For ACE intake today AWS accepted placeholders for pricing and a note that final pricing will be provided prior to listing.

We confirm the call with Karthik (PDM) and the AWS PSM on Wed 11/19 10:00 PT. Also looping in our procurement lead (procurement@northern-tech.com) for any contracting questions.

Next steps for Redwood prior to the call: 1) share a short tech readiness checklist (container/image access + sample payloads), 2) drop any marketplace asset specs (logo sizes, description length), and 3) send a calendar invite including the MAP link so we can edit live.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Desai
Director of Partnerships, Northern Tech
priya.desai@northern-tech.com
